::: {#prp-reducible-risk-zero}
#### The reducible risk is zero only for the conditional mean

The [reducible risk](#def-reducible-risk) is zero [if and only if](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/proof-writing.html#def-iff) the [prediction function](#def-prediction-function) $\predfn$ equals the [conditional expectation function](#def-cond-expectation-function) with [probability](probability-basics.qmd#def-probability) 1:

$$
\E{\sqf{\E{\Outvar \mid \Predvar} - \predfnf{\Predvar}}} = 0
\iff
\P(\predfnf{\Predvar} = \E{\Outvar \mid \Predvar}) = 1
$$

:::

::: proof

Write $Z = \sqf{\E{\Outvar \mid \Predvar} - \predfnf{\Predvar}}$.
Since $x^2 \ge 0$ for every $x$, with $x^2 = 0$ only at $x = 0$,
$Z \ge 0$,
and $Z = 0$ exactly when $\predfnf{\Predvar} = \E{\Outvar \mid \Predvar}$.

**($\Leftarrow$)** If $\P(Z = 0) = 1$, then $Z$ takes the value 0 with [probability](probability-basics.qmd#def-probability) 1, so $\E{Z} = 0$ by the [definition of expectation](#def-expectation).

**($\Rightarrow$)** Suppose $\E{Z} = 0$, and fix $a > 0$.
Since $Z \ge 0$, and $Z \ge a$ on the [event](probability-basics.qmd#def-event) $\set{Z \ge a}$:

$$
\ba
Z &\ge a \cd \1{Z \ge a}
&& \text{(on } \set{Z \ge a} \text{ the right side is } a \le Z \text{; elsewhere it is } 0 \le Z \text{)}
\\ \E{Z} &\ge \E{a \cd \1{Z \ge a}}
&& \text{(expectation preserves inequalities)}
\\ &= a \cd \P(Z \ge a)
&& \text{(the expectation of an indicator is the probability of its event)}
\ea
$$

With $\E{Z} = 0$, the displayed chain gives $a \cd \P(Z \ge a) \le 0$, so $\P(Z \ge a) = 0$.
The events $\set{Z \ge 1/n}$ for $n = 1, 2, \ldots$ increase to the event $\set{Z > 0}$,
so by the [continuity of probability](probability-basics.qmd#thm-continuity-probability):

$$
\ba
\P(Z > 0)
&= \lim_{n \to \infty} \P(Z \ge 1/n)
&& \text{(continuity of probability)}
\\ &= 0
&& \text{(each term is 0, taking } a = 1/n \text{)}
\ea
$$

Hence $\P(Z = 0) = 1 - \P(Z > 0) = 1$.

:::
